The Fastest Production Bike Ever Made

Top Speed 80mph, 60 Miles Per Charge

Includes Volcano DNM Motorcycle Shock and Dual Front Hydraulic Disc Braking System (Shipping $450 by Freight in Wooden Crate – Less Chance of Damage.)

This One-of-A-kind Superbike has a feature that no other similar bike has because all the components are Plug-and-Play. We have gone as far as to design our own high wattage patent-pending plug which allows even the motor to be unplugged for easy tube or tire replacement.

(Maximum Speed 80 mph, Maximum Distance per Charge 60 Miles.) The E-cheetah is a 15,000 Watt Super One-of-a-Kind Electric Bike with Full Suspension, (Front and Rear), This bike goes head to head with a dirt bike, yet is not gas-powered driven and so it is not restricted in many parks.

This cart not only has four wheels which are specially designed to go up and down and over any terrain. It also has puncture-proof, (foam-filled), extra-wide tires at 6” wide and 16” diameter. This cart can not only be used for backcountry hunting or fishing but with its extra-wide tires, it can also be used to haul beach gear, and sports equipment, and since it folds up, it will fit in almost any vehicle. Our GenerTRX Power Generation System can be applied to all four wheels.
